name: makita-postgresql-precheck-guardrail
description: Governs the Pre-Check MCP Server — restricts to pre-check read actions on PostgreSQL, blocks prompt injection and malicious content.
blockedInputMessaging: Operation blocked by guardrail policy. The requested input violates the MAKITA pre-check guardrail. Only disaster recovery pre-check operations on the PostgreSQL cluster are permitted.
blockedOutputsMessaging: Response blocked by guardrail policy. The generated output violates the MAKITA pre-check guardrail constraints.

topicsConfig.name: non-dr-operations
topicsConfig.definition: Any operations that are not related to disaster recovery pre-checks, replication health verification, primary status checks, or replica readiness verification for the MAKITA system.
